Container.Name: Smart Array P410
Container.Overview: Manage HP Smart Array controllers (P410, P410i, P212, P812 and related G6/G7 models) from the Unraid GUI. Shows controller, cache and battery status and maps every drive bay to its logical drive, /dev device and Unraid slot. Read SMART through the controller (cciss), toggle the locate LED, create a RAID0 logical drive for a new disk and delete unused logical drives without rebooting. Optional periodic SMART checks with Unraid notifications and MQTT publishing with Home Assistant discovery, plus a Dashboard tile. Uses HPE hpssacli, downloaded from the official HPE repository during installation. English and Polish UI.
